short_description: Cannot connect to VPN from home office
description: After updating my macOS client, GlobalProtect VPN refuses to connect. Error code 0x3A. I've tried restarting and reinstalling the client but the issue persists.

short_description: Mouse not working at my desk
description: Wireless mouse stopped responding this morning. Replaced batteries with no effect. Need a replacement.

short_description: Badge not opening the front door
description: My access badge stopped working at the main entrance and the elevator. Other floors seem fine. Currently waiting on a re-encode at the security desk.

short_description: Database migration script failing on staging
description: The nightly migration job has been failing for the last three runs with a constraint violation on the user_groups table. Logs attached.

short_description: Code deployment pipeline timing out on prod release
description: Jenkins job hits the 30-minute timeout on the deploy-prod stage. This started after the build cluster move. Blocking the next release.
Customer reports of checkout failures spiking. p99 latency on /v1/checkout has crossed 8s. Errors look like upstream timeouts to the payments cluster.

short_description: DNS lookup intermittent on internal subdomain
description: internal.acme.local was failing to resolve from the New York office last Tuesday. Resolved after the upstream DNS cache was flushed.

short_description: Office365 license expired for contractor account
description: Contractor mailbox locked out. License renewed manually and the account was reactivated. Closing the ticket.

short_description: Cannot access shared drive on file server
description: Affected user lost access to the engineering shared drive after the SSO migration. Group membership had to be re-applied.

short_description: SSL certificate expired on internal portal
description: intranet.acme.com is throwing cert errors in Chrome. Need to renew the wildcard cert and roll the load balancer.
